datasets.note: Versioned independent public-data experiment. Missing legacy B0/X1/X2 code is superseded by user instruction and is not a prerequisite. Force labels are subjective instructed categories, not measured mechanical force. Final cohort results remain descriptive; no own-device or deployment claim.

primary_metadata_review.paper_review: Author repository and README reviewed; linked full paper not reviewed.
primary_metadata_review.layout: Four Trigno Quattro sensors, two staggered rows of eight; first row starts at extensor carpi ulnaris.
limitations: Recording starts after position and grasp formation to avoid transitions; not automatic onset/offset ground truth.
Nine-position grid described, five positions acquired; do not invent nine acquired conditions.
README repeats day1block2 in its four-folder listing; native names must be inspected.

current_primary_review_v2.paper_review: Official Europe PMC JATS full text retrieved; acquisition, records, validation protocol and usage sections reviewed. Author-hosted PDF returned403; figures were not visually reviewed.
current_primary_review_v2.layout: Four Quattro sensors yield16 EMG channels in two staggered rows of8; first row starts at extensor carpi ulnaris.
boundaries: Day and noncentral position sets are confounded. Five positions are acquired per day, not nine per day.
Only five-second holds are stored per trial; cue timing is not physiological onset/offset truth. No new native data, six-axis IMU, stored-column wiring or benchmark reproduction.

primary_metadata_review.paper: Palermo et al., Analysis of the repeatability of grasp recognition for hand robotic prosthesis control based on sEMG data, ICORR (2017).
primary_metadata_review.paper_review: Author's six-page paper retrieved; acquisition/synchronization/analysis paragraphs extracted and pages 2/3 visually reviewed. Reported experiments not reproduced.
primary_metadata_review.layout: Eight Trigno sensors in proximal ring, six below; two EMG columns and six acceleration columns empty according to official variables.
limitations: Acceleration is sampled at 148.148 Hz then interpolated to 2000 Hz; aligned export rows are not native IMU rate.
No synchronized gyro confirmed; do not infer full six-axis eligibility from inertial modality label.
Official preprocessed ZIP links visible; raw data and acquisition access not tested.

primary_metadata_review.paper: Pradhan, He and Jiang, Multi-day dataset of forearm and wrist electromyogram for hand gesture recognition and biometrics, Scientific Data 9, 733 (2022).
primary_metadata_review.paper_review: Official Europe PMC JATS full text retrieved; acquisition, protocol, preprocessing, waveform and usage sections reviewed. See GRAB_PRIMARY_TOPOLOGY_V1.json; no figure or performance reproduction claim.
primary_metadata_review.layout: Official metadata assigns F1-F8 to columns1-8 and forearm ring1, F9-F16 to columns9-16 and ring2; unused columns17/24/25/32. Existing672-record subset headers and signal checksums are verified. Circumferential direction and our device wiring remain unverified; no differential-pair transformation assumed.
limitations: Public stored-column identity does not authenticate our device wiring, arm, direction or bipolar subtraction sign.
Figure and supplementary geometry are not visually reviewed; selected text sections do not reproduce paper performance.
primary_metadata_review.stored_signal_montage: Monopolar columns; bipolar pairs can be constructed separately. Current F1-F8 selection retains eight single-ring monopolar signals.

primary_metadata_review.paper: Pizzolato et al., Comparison of six electromyography acquisition setups on hand movement classification tasks (2017).
primary_metadata_review.paper_review: Article title, public-data statement and official acquisition guidelines read; not exhaustive full-paper validation.
primary_metadata_review.layout: Two eight-channel Myo rings; second tilted 22.5 degrees clockwise. Acceleration from first Myo.
limitations: Acceleration does not establish synchronized gyro, raw units or guided body-frame calibration.
Paper's DB5 data DOI resolves to dataset 4; corrected author record 1000116 independently confirms DB5 identity and license.
Official subject ZIP links are visible; native download access was not tested.

primary_metadata_review.paper: Open Access Dataset, Toolbox and Benchmark Processing Results of High-Density Surface Electromyogram Recordings; DOI 10.1109/TNSRE.2021.3082551.
primary_metadata_review.paper_review: Publisher-linked citation; equipment geometry not independently reviewed.
primary_metadata_review.layout: High-density array; not an eight-channel circumferential device.
limitations: PR gesture task and four synchronous force subtasks are distinct; no force trajectory inferred for PR.
No new raw download or native experiment in this review.

current_primary_review_v2.paper_review: Official v1 author manuscript acquisition/protocol and Figure1 reviewed; official v2 equipment sheet reviewed. This is not a reproduction of published benchmarks.

facts.synchronization: Task-onset trigger sent to EMG and force acquisition systems.

current_primary_review_v2.layout: Four64-channel8x8 arrays, two per flexor/extensor side; array1-4 signals concatenated. Figure1 gives within-array numbering, not an eight-channel circumferential ring.
boundaries: Author manuscript belongs to dataset v1; equipment sheet is v2. This does not prove all v1/v2 raw files are identical.
Finger-force subtasks and PR gestures remain distinct. No new raw population download, header mapping, IMU calibration or performance reproduction.

primary_metadata_review.paper: ReactEMG: Stable, Low-Latency Intent Detection from sEMG via Masked Modeling; arXiv 2506.19815.
primary_metadata_review.paper_review: arXiv v6 selected inference, datasets, training, metrics and limitations sections reviewed; full model results not reproduced.
limitations: Code license does not prove hosted mixed data-archive license.
Use existing native ROAM static subset audit for channel/rate; do not infer properties from model generalization claims.
ROAM three-class task excludes pinch;50-sample smoothing uses future data (.25s at200Hz). Native112-static-record audit does not cover all published tasks.

datasets.note: Optional secondary archive; sampled missing fields reject two full recordings; not historical DS2; no classifier scores.

primary_metadata_review.paper: Miljkovic and Isakovic, Effect of the sEMG electrode (re) placement and feature set size on the hand movement recognition; DOI 10.1016/j.bspc.2020.102292.
primary_metadata_review.paper_review: Publisher-linked citation; paper retrieval failed this review.
primary_metadata_review.layout: CH1 through CH8; detailed assembly/position referred to linked paper and not verified here.
limitations: Record describes at least ten repetitions but no sample-level repetition boundaries supplied in eight-column files.
Some analysis repetitions discarded; cannot reconstruct segmentation from count alone.

current_primary_review_v2.paper_review: Author arXiv2005.02105v2 acquisition, protocol, processing and limitations reviewed; PDFpage5/Figures1-2 visually checked. Paper links the Zenodo4039550 dataset.
current_primary_review_v2.layout: Eight uniformly circumferential bipolar pairs; reference over elbow bone. Figure2 shows the shift, but does not label raw columns CH1-CH8 around the arm.
boundaries: A2cm circumferential displacement is not a2-degree rotation. Re-donning is within one recording session, not across days.
Requested5+3second timing does not reconstruct retained/discarded repetitions or sample-level action labels. Circumferential channel order and differential sign remain unattested.
